relationships.subject: Gepants
relationships.evidence_quote: Small molecule CGRP-R antagonists are effective in acute migraine therapy in women but available data do not demonstrate effectiveness in men.

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-targeting therapies are effective for migraine prevention in both male and female episodic migraine patients but possible sex differences remain uncertain.

key_findings: Gepants showed significant acute efficacy in women but not men in FDA data subanalysis.
CGRP mAbs were similarly effective in male and female chronic migraine patients.
